title: Smooth proper models of one-variable fields over an algebraically closed field
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field (every nonconstant polynomial over $k$ has a root) [def-weil-field], and let $E/k$ be a finitely generated field extension of transcendence degree one [def-kun-transcendence-degree]. There exists a smooth integral proper finite-type $k$-scheme $C$ of dimension one [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] and a $k$-isomorphism $k(C)\cong E$, where $k(C)$ is the local ring at the generic point. For every valuation ring $B\subseteq E$ [def-trf-valuation-ring] containing $k$, the generic-point morphism $\operatorname{Spec}E\to C$ extends to a $k$-morphism $\operatorname{Spec}B\to C$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum].

source.place: Tag 0BY1 (theorem-curves-rational-maps), existence of a normal projective model, and Tag 0BY3 (lemma-nonsingular-model-smooth), smoothness over a perfect field; the final clause is the proper valuative criterion (lemma-nagata-proper-valuative-criterion-existence-api).
